# SIMD dependency license

`uuid-simd 0.8.0` and `vsimd 0.8.0` declare MIT licensing but omit the license text from their crate archives.
Their `.cargo_vcs_info.json` files identify commit `d74c030d9dc4f3cae02146d1f497ff62726ef09a` in `https://github.com/Nugine/simd`.

`LICENSE` is the unmodified repository-wide license downloaded from:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nugine/simd/d74c030d9dc4f3cae02146d1f497ff62726ef09a/LICENSE

The distribution builder uses it only when the repository, commit and license expression match this record.
